description: This file defines a FastAPI-based backend API for a simple notes application. It includes data models with Pydantic, database initialization and connection management with SQLite, and REST API endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes, as well as a health check. The code also handles environment variables and CORS middleware configuration.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a note, including id, title, content, created_at, and updated_at.

classes.name: NoteCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a new note, requiring title and content.

classes.name: NoteUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating a note, allowing optional title and content fields.

methods.name: _utc_now_iso
methods.description: Returns current UTC timestamp in ISO format as a string.

methods.name: _get_env
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable values with a default fallback.

methods.name: _row_to_note
methods.description: Converts a SQLite row into a Note instance.

methods.name: _init_db
methods.description: Initializes the database by creating the notes table if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: _db
methods.description: Context manager for SQLite database connection, handling setup and cleanup.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Health check endpoint that provides status and database path.

methods.name: list_notes
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a list of notes, optionally filtered by title search.

methods.name: create_note
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new note with provided title and content.

methods.name: get_note
methods.description: Endpoint to fetch a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: update_note
methods.description: Endpoint to update an existing note, modifying title and/or content.

methods.name: delete_note
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a note by its ID.
